question: Which vehicle makes a 'Chug-Chug' sound on the tracks? 🚂
explanation: Awesome! A train goes 'Chug-Chug' and 'Choo-Choo' as it moves on the long iron tracks! 🚂
hint: It has an engine and many coaches.

question: Which shape is best for drawing the wheels of a car? 🔴
explanation: Great job! Wheels are round like circles so they can roll smoothly on the road! 🔴
hint: It has no corners.

question: What sound does a car horn make? 🚗
explanation: Super! Cars go 'Beep Beep' to let people know they are coming! 🚗
hint: You press the steering wheel to make this sound.

question: Which vehicle zooms high up in the sky? ☁️
explanation: Awesome! Airplanes have wings and fly very fast in the sky! ✈️
hint: You go to an airport to catch this.

question: What shape is the long body of a bus? 🚌
explanation: Great job! A bus is long and straight, just like a big rectangle! 🟩
hint: It has two long sides and two short sides.

question: Which color do we use to draw a sunny sky? ☀️
explanation: Super! A bright day has a beautiful blue sky! 🔵
hint: It is the same color as the ocean.

question: How can we show a car is moving fast in a drawing? 🏎️
explanation: Awesome! Drawing lines behind a car makes it look like it is zooming fast! 💨
hint: They look like blowing wind.

question: Where do boats travel? ⛵
explanation: Great job! Boats float and splash in the water! 🌊
hint: Fish live here.

question: What shape can we use for the sail of a boat? ⛵
explanation: Super! The sail catches the wind and looks just like a triangle! 🔺
hint: It has three sides.

question: Which vehicle has only two round wheels? 🚲
explanation: Awesome! You pedal a bicycle to make its two wheels spin! 🚲
hint: It goes 'Ring-Ring'.

question: What sound does a bicycle bell make? 🔔
explanation: Great job! You press the bell and it goes 'Ring-Ring' to say hello! 🔔
hint: It sounds like a telephone.

question: To draw a road, which color do we mostly use? 🛣️
explanation: Super! Roads are made of dark tar, so we color them black or dark grey! ⚫
hint: It is a very dark color.

question: What do we call a drawing of beautiful nature and roads? 🏞️
explanation: Awesome! When we draw hills, trees, and roads, it is called scenery! 🏞️
hint: It shows a wide view of outside.

question: Which light tells the vehicles to STOP? 🚦
explanation: Great job! A red traffic light means all cars must stop safely! 🔴
hint: It is the color of an apple.

question: Which vehicle has three wheels and is yellow and green? 🛺
explanation: Super! An auto-rickshaw goes putt-putt and has exactly three wheels! 🛺
hint: You see many of these in the city.

question: If we draw a car with big curvy wavy lines under it, where is it? 🌊
explanation: Awesome! Wavy lines mean water, so maybe it's a magic boat car! 🌊
hint: Fish swim in it.

question: Which vehicle travels up into space to see stars? 🚀
explanation: Great job! Rockets have fire at the bottom to zoom into space! 🚀
hint: It goes very, very fast straight up.

question: How do you feel when you go on a fun trip? 😊
explanation: Super! Traveling to new places is very exciting and makes us happy! 😊
hint: You smile a lot.

question: What do we add to our train drawing to show smoke? 💨
explanation: Awesome! Drawing puffy clouds coming from the engine looks just like smoke! ☁️
hint: They look like cotton balls.

question: Which color is the school bus usually? 🚌
explanation: Great job! School buses are bright yellow so everyone can see them easily! 🟡
hint: It is the color of the sun.

question: What part of the car do we look through to see outside? 🪟
explanation: Super! Windows are made of clear glass so we can enjoy the view! 🪟
hint: They are usually square or rectangle.

question: Which light tells the vehicles to GO? 🚦
explanation: Awesome! The green traffic light means the road is clear to go! 🟢
hint: It is the color of grass.

question: What shape is a train's window? 🔲
explanation: Great job! Train windows are lovely squares where we sit and look out! 🔲
hint: It has four equal sides.

question: Which large vehicle carries a lot of heavy things? 🚚
explanation: Super! Trucks have big boxes in the back to carry heavy loads! 🚚
hint: It is much bigger than a car.

question: What flies in the sky but does not have an engine? 🪁
explanation: Awesome! A kite dances in the wind on a long string! 🪁
hint: You fly it on a breezy day.

question: Which animal pulls a cart in the village? 🐎
explanation: Great job! A horse is very strong and can pull a cart easily! 🐎
hint: It goes 'Neigh'.

question: To draw a night journey, we fill the sky with? ⭐
explanation: Super! Twinkling stars and the moon make a beautiful night drawing! ⭐
hint: They shine in the dark.

question: Which vehicle uses a rotor on top to fly? 🚁
explanation: Awesome! The spinning blades on top help the helicopter lift straight up! 🚁
hint: It goes chop-chop-chop.

question: What do we draw next to the road to show nature? 🌳
explanation: Great job! Green trees make our road drawings look fresh and beautiful! 🌳
hint: They have green leaves.

question: Which color do we use for a shiny red fire engine? 🚒
explanation: Super! Fire engines are bright red so everyone sees them coming! 🚒
hint: It is the color of a tomato.

question: How do we draw water for our boat? 🌊
explanation: Awesome! Wavy lines look just like splashing water in a river! 🌊
hint: Like the letter 'S'.

question: Which vehicle travels completely under the water? 🚢
explanation: Great job! A submarine dives deep into the ocean to explore! 🚢
hint: It is shaped like a big tube.

question: What is the front part of a train called? 🚂
explanation: Super! The strong engine pulls all the other coaches behind it! 🚂
hint: It is where the driver sits.

question: What shape do we draw to make a hot air balloon? 🎈
explanation: Awesome! A hot air balloon is a giant oval shape full of warm air! 🎈
hint: It looks like a giant egg.

question: What sound does an airplane make in the sky? ✈️
explanation: Great job! Airplanes go 'Zooooom' as they fly super fast! ✈️
hint: A very loud and fast sound.

question: If we color the sky orange and yellow, what time is it? 🌅
explanation: Super! Orange and yellow colors make a beautiful sunset in our art! 🌅
hint: When the sun goes down.

question: Which light tells vehicles to slow down and wait? 🚦
explanation: Awesome! A yellow light means get ready to stop safely! 🟡
hint: It is the color of a banana.

question: Which part helps the airplane to fly? 🪽
explanation: Great job! Just like birds, airplanes need big wings to glide in the air! 🪽
hint: They stick out on the sides.

question: Which animal is the 'Ship of the Desert'? 🐪
explanation: Super! Camels walk easily on hot sand, making them great for desert travel! 🐪
hint: It has humps on its back.

question: To draw a muddy road, which color is best? 🟤
explanation: Awesome! Brown is the perfect color to show soft, squishy mud! 🟤
hint: It is the color of chocolate.

question: Which vehicle do farmers use in their fields? 🚜
explanation: Great job! Tractors have very big wheels to drive on bumpy farm dirt! 🚜
hint: It is used to grow food.

question: When we draw a bus, what goes inside the big rectangle? 🚌
explanation: Super! We draw lots of small square windows so the passengers can see! 🚌
hint: People look out of these.

question: Which vehicle has no engine and you push with your foot? 🛴
explanation: Awesome! A kick scooter is so much fun to ride in the park! 🛴
hint: You stand on it and kick the ground.

question: If you are drawing a boat, what do you draw below it? 🐟
explanation: Great job! A boat always needs water to float on! 🌊
hint: It is blue and wavy.

question: What is it called when cars are stuck and cannot move? 🚗🚙
explanation: Super! Sometimes there are too many cars, and they have to wait patiently! 🚗🚙
hint: Lots of honking happens here.

question: Which vehicle goes very fast on ice and snow? 🛷
explanation: Awesome! Sleds slide smoothly down snowy hills! 🛷
hint: Santa uses a big one.

question: Which tool do we use first to sketch our travel drawing? ✏️
explanation: Great job! We use a pencil first so we can easily fix any mistakes! ✏️
hint: It is grey and has an eraser on top.

question: What do we use to fill bright colors in our drawings? 🖍️
explanation: Super! Crayons make our travel drawings bright, happy, and colorful! 🖍️
hint: They come in a box of many colors.

question: Where does a train stop to pick up people? 🚉
explanation: Awesome! We buy tickets and wait at the big railway station! 🚉
hint: It has long platforms.

question: After a long journey, where do we return to? 🏡
explanation: Great job! Every wonderful journey ends at our sweet home! 🏡
hint: Where you live with your family.
